name: PREREG_<experiment>_v1
_how: Copy this file, fill every field, run a pilot on pilot seeds only, then: python seal_prereg.py seal PREREG_<experiment>_v1.json --freeze <code files>. After sealing, change nothing; report results as measured.
question: <one sentence: what the experiment decides>

conditions.<name>: <how this condition decides, e.g. large model every step / router + large model / script only>

seed_note: <train, test and pilot seeds never overlap>
tau_source: <fixed a priori, or set on pilot seeds only; never on test seeds>
trigger_source: <e.g. same as v2.2, fixed a priori>
success: <execution-verified final state: what counts as success, read from the environment, never from the decider>
metrics: <wrong fast actions and whether each was caught>
stop_rule: results reported as measured; no re-run with changed tau, trigger or criteria under this PREREG; failed hypotheses are reported as failed
safety: <machines, accounts, network; what the experiment never touches>
